source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    # The dominant color is the background; use the other color as the new background\n    # and turn the marked cells into 0.\n    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)\n    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    foreground = next(color for color in counts if color != background)\n    return [[foreground if cell == background else 0 for cell in row] for row in grid]\n'''
